body:
CANONICAL: live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents. Source Engram::Fable. Each line names the TermAl item whose fix retires it; revise this entry when one is fixed. TermAl CREDIT never gates an Engram landing: the launcher's own freeze check (results.json expected = before = after) does. Rev 94 (2026-10-31 18:22Z) condenses stale lines and adds the DL560 credit overlap; older texts are in earlier revisions.

!! REVIEW INTEGRITY (P1 w-9d4b9b00c603): a COMPACT result can say "Findings: None" while the FULL output lists findings. Judge every review, explorer or evaluator result ONLY from the FULL output. Native exact-attempt reads work from a root in the original review project with delegationId, submissionAttempt AND resultId pinned on every page (w-b67f01f154e6). Cross-project reads can 404 "review attempt has no confirmed publication"; the original-project owner then transfers only the missing result once, complete, with its identity and hash, into main .evidence. Prose cannot replace missing results.
!! REVIEW BRIEF DROPPED (w-03f5e1cd2f30): `/review-code <text>` silently DROPS <text>. Use `/review-code -- <instructions>`, then read back the stored delegation.prompt.
!! AMBIGUOUS ENGRAM WRITE (Engram w-b1ae95ab86d7): a write can return busy_budget_exhausted / acquisition_not_started although it COMMITTED. READ BACK before any retry.
!! CLAUDE SESSIONS: never start a background Bash task, Monitor or subagent. No `engram doctor` on a live store. No foreground Bash in the coordinator while an Engram gate or credited run is in flight (w-350df830dfd0).
!! CLAUDE REVIEWERS: default model Opus; Sonnet, then Kimi, only if a fresh Opus attempt is refused (record the refusal). Kimi never stands in for both reviewers.
!! A CLAUDE EXPLORER IS NOT READ-ONLY (P1 w-dc7657cc3529): spawn read-only Claude delegations in REVIEWER mode.
!! REVIEW AND FREEZE IDENTITY: Git by default (memory rules-greg-git-identity-2026-10-29).

CHECKS AND CREDIT
- Run checks through `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- ...` (or full). A BARE command that outlives its turn loses its result (w-8f7e2d914724).
- CLAUDE lanes: ONE call `pushd "DIR" && <test>` is credited; piping, chaining or an env prefix is not (w-1d9259ed138e; until TermAl w-fec83085cff0 lands).
- A --target-dir outside the named root is refused credit (w-32d02e1dd7f6).
- !! DL560 JOB OVERLAP (P1 w-f5f89e7eed42; fix 763d899a pending TermAl's next batch): while the DL560 runner proxy session-15580 is in a turn (any DL560 job running), TermAl withholds credit for EVERY Central worktree. Time credited local runs for DL560 idle, or record the refusal ONCE under rules-greg-common-sense §3 and carry on. Never retire session-15580.
- SETTLEMENT LAG (w-667e66aecbff): after a terminal result, END the turn; edit the root only in the NEXT turn.
- Overlapped checks are indeterminate (w-10eafa34c480). Codex: a focused run is recorded only if it ends in its starting turn (w-67d248c998ef).
- A cancelled or idle delegation may keep a worktree folder locked (w-eaee4f7c441c): leave it.
- ANY command by a non-Claude session in a carried gate's root refuses that gate's credit (w-4a8d9a7a7d08).
- With gated control OFF, a gate run is base-mode: no typed host credit arrives (w-af3c30bfe828). Never rerun only for credit.
- Remote DL560/Windows B/Mac results are not host credit until Engram w-180d6f507470 and TermAl K3 ship.

WAKES AND MAIL
- A send receipt describes dispatch at send time, not current wake/failure. For a suspected gap read the exact message state and the TARGET's processedThrough; never resend on an old durableButNotWoken receipt alone (w-1df557dae3ac; wording TermAl w-4d5a). A grant unread for about 15 min is withdrawn.
- Idempotency keys are unique per SENDER (w-b7b80d980e7a): use recipient-qualified keys.
- Use plain "session-N" for local recipients; "host:<central>::session-N" creates a new mailbox (w-623c0e4ca176).
- A runner "named GO" relayed by a coder may be mis-attributed; the issuer confirms it directly to the runner.

NAMED SOURCE ROOTS
- Never root credited work at MAIN; use a clean detached worktree (.worktrees/NAME). termal_name_source_root takes effect next turn; the owner needs a continuation message to bind. Clear after done; an own-clear 409 "holds no live claim" (w-b964389ee54a): leave it.
- EVALUATION 409s (P1 w-33f4cde5413c): (a) after a fresh naming or ANY tracker write, END the turn, wait ≥60 s, evaluate in a separate turn; (b) "stopped naming the source root": re-name, end the turn, ONE fresh evaluation; (c) after landing, name the LANDED root; (d) the evaluator cites ONLY the holder's own notes; (e) "no sighting of named root": superseded by Engram B (w-da8c79e5d5ab) once landed and installed; until then an earlier matching sighting still admits.
- SECOND ITEM IN ONE SESSION (w-6cf3141a12c3): switch focus, checkpoint, END idle, then ONE fresh evaluator.
- After a host restart, claims may lapse (recover them with a reason).

FREEZE AND GATES: stage by explicit `git add` (w-13b44cf369af). Candidate commits per AGENTS option B. Remote gates per rules-greg-equivalent-gate-hosts-2026-10-28 with a named GO from the lane's coordinator (DL560 Engram lanes: Engram::Fable; Central, Windows B and Mac: Termal::Fable2). DL560 admits parallel jobs by resource census (dl560-runner-checklist). A failed gate discards that round's reviews.

EVALUATIONS (P1 w-539ea7e8b506): no tracker write in the turn of termal_evaluate_acceptance. ONE fresh evaluator if a settled one is not reusable (w-049ac52c3f72). Each criterionEvidence body is capped at 16 KiB (w-4c12f6badafc). START 503 "first-brief durable acknowledgement failed" (w-4c5d81531009): ONE identical retry. Non-holder notes are not citable (409). Read-only leaves can't run Engram read words (w-dea9f053cd70). A broken evaluation mechanism follows rules-greg-common-sense-2026-10-30.
SPAWN HOLD persistenceUnknown (w-a6c410f4f558): re-check after 1-2 min; cancel only after about 5 min and report it.
FOLLOW-UP TO A COMPLETED DELEGATION can 500 on "thread/unarchive" (w-d383c82bdeeb): ONE fresh replacement.
KIMI read-only delegations can be refused with a misleading "user rejected the approval request" (w-abb468dfd14b).
APPROVALS AND QUEUES: Codex lanes are on host AUTO-APPROVE. queuePaused under a minute between turns is normal. A stuck head (w-7635e5349aab) or a model-capacity error: ask Fable2; same model, Resume after 5 minutes.
STALE RECOVERY: a runner's stale-run recovery can report a completed run as active (TermAl w-e2833c8c13b4, P2): reconcile the existing terminal; never rerun.
OTHER: TermAl's strict AcceptanceBindingEvidenceVerification lacks Engram's optional `bound` field (w-540531f46f53 C4). After an OS crash SQLite can lose the last minutes of commits (Engram w-088e358107e0). termal_list_sessions fields vary by build (w-25199ca6ef59).
CODEX DELETE BLOCKED (TermAl w-ed7d67ec9514): a Codex integration owner's recursive delete in .logs, .evidence, target or .worktrees is refused; `git worktree remove` works. The Engram coordinator deletes those folders after a path check.
LAUNCHER NOTICE LOOKS LIKE THE OWNER: a --notify result arrives with the RUN OWNER as sender; the recipient relays it at once (rules-waits-and-wakes 1a).

- Evaluation 409 "TermAl has no named source root (it reads the session's workdir)" (seen 2026-10-31 22:18Z on d782 after the restart; TermAl w-b0f06fffa4d8, P2). The likely trigger is a LAPSED claim (a held claim kept its named root across the same restart). Workaround: reclaim the item, run termal_name_source_root on the bound root, and request ONE evaluation on the next turn.
